The '''Monedes'mai Hypercanal''' was a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|trade route]] used by the [[Bith/Legends|Bith]],<ref name="TNEGtC" /> a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Clak'dor VII/Legends|Clak'dor VII]].<ref name="LotE" />

==History==
In around [[5500 BBY/Legends|5500 BBY]], [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]] [[Merchant/Legends|merchants]],<ref name="TNEGtC" /> especially [[Herglic/Legends|Herglics]] and [[Givin/Legends|Givin]], linked hundreds of preexisting [[praedium]]s in the southern quadrant of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] to form the first leg of the [[Rimma Trade Route/Legends|Rimma Trade Route]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> During that [[Time/Legends|time]], [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] merchants discovered the Tapani [[Sector/Legends|sector]], leading their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]], in the [[Brema sector/Legends|Brema sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], to join the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="SoR">''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]''</ref> The [[Galactic Rim/Legends|Rimward]] leg of the Rimma Trade Route was then [[Scout/Legends|blazed]] by Sullustan [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] and Givin [[Cartographer/Legends|cartographers]].<ref name="TEA" />

[[File:Rimma_Trade_Route.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The Tapani sector and the Bith homeworld Clak'dor VII were connected by the Rimma Trade Route]]
In around [[3000 BBY]], the Tapani sector [[Hyperspace route/Legends|trade lanes]] were connected with the Monedes'mai Hypercanal, a route used by the [[Bith/Legends|Bith]],<ref name="TNEGtC" /> a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Clak'dor VII/Legends|Clak'dor VII]],<ref name="LotE" /> in the [[Mayagil sector/Legends|Mayagil sector]] of the Outer Rim Territories.<ref name="EAOC" /> This connection marked the formation of the modern Rimma Trade Route.<ref name="TNEGtC" />

With the Rimma Trade Route connecting the Tapani sector and Clak'dor VII, members of the Bith species were commonly seen in the [[Freeworlds Territory]] during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]].<ref name="LotE" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Monedes'mai Hypercanal was first mentioned in the ''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]'', a [[2002]] reference book written by [[Daniel Wallace]].<ref name="TNEGtC" />

Although ''The New Essential Guide to Characters'' dates the connection between the Tapani sector and the Bith route to 3000 BBY,<ref name="TNEGtC" /> the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', co-written by Daniel Wallace and [[Jason Fry]], shows the Rimma Trade Route already blazed to Clak'dor VII, [[Sluis Van/Legends|Sluis Van]] and [[Elrood/Legends|Elrood]] by [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]]. ''The Essential Atlas'' also shows a completely charted Rimma Trade Route during the blazing of the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]] around [[3700 BBY/Legends|3700 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" />
